lede: Tuesday night, Town Council takes up third reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code — a vote that would rewrite historic review standards and landscaping rules for property owners across Telluride, so this one is worth showing up for. Ridgway's council is equally busy Wednesday with a public hearing on the Hyde Subdivision resubdivision and a joint work session on its state-mandated Housing Action Plan. San Miguel County's Planning Commission meets Thursday on subdivision mechanics and a building energy code update that would set new standards for construction county-wide.

notable.stake: Third-reading vote rewrites historic review and landscaping rules for all property owners.
Public hearing on Hyde Subdivision resubdivision; council also reviews state-mandated Housing Action Plan.
County weighs subdivision land-use rules and a building energy code update affecting new construction.
